note: Town of Clover campground on Lake Superior's south shore at Herbster, off Bark Point Road. The water-and-electric RV sites sit in an open block across the road from the beach, the front row (22-27) looking over the lake; the electric-only sites by the pavilion take only small rigs, and the rustic tent sites are on the beach side or in the woods. Playground. Charging an electric vehicle at the sites is prohibited. --Claude
